items.summary: CTO review: approve containment-only execution. Continue existing measurement, attribution reconciliation, failed-work repair-or-close review, and bounded legal/security evidence work. Do not create or queue new production work, requeue failures, add telemetry, change configuration, add dependencies, spend, expand monetization, conduct external outreach, or adopt external components. Preserve deferred opportunities until queue capacity, isolation, validation, rollback, security, and owner gates are clear. Keep unsupported revenue, causal, performance, and operational outcomes unknown.

Continue existing financial evidence reconciliation using available telemetry only. Do not assign aggregate commission to any site or claim ROI, margin, payback, cost-to-learn, budget headroom, or causal lift. Reconcile conflicting AI-usage records and record only already-available period-aligned costs; unavailable costs and limits remain unknown.

Keep the gated product private. Continue the existing consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix; keep external outreach, public exposure, alert expansion, deployment, configuration or credential changes, rights-dependent monetization, and spend blocked pending human-counsel review, owner authorization, and completion of legal, security, accuracy, attribution, and measurement gates.

Preserve failed-work isolation. Continue repair-or-close review without requeueing failures or creating replacement work. Any future resumption requires canonical lineage, ownership, root cause, smallest isolated repair, focused deterministic validation, rollback evidence, deduplication, and explicit requeue-or-close disposition.
